title: The Japanese Footbridge
themes: constructed nature, reflection, enclosure, water garden, contemplation
description: A turquoise bridge compresses the upper edge while water lilies, dense greenery, and reflected forms fill the pond below.

title: The Seine at Giverny
description: Rounded trees and their reflections divide a placid river scene around a central horizon, painted with loose strokes in cool greens, blues, and violets.

title: Argenteuil
themes: leisure, river, modern life, industry, figures, movement
description: A bright riverside road, sailboats, trees, people, distant buildings, and smokestacks bring leisure and modern industry into one landscape.

title: Cliffs at Pourville
themes: coast, elevated viewpoint, tourism, wind, boats, open distance
description: Two figures occupy green cliffs above a broad blue sea filled with small boats; an elevated view opens the scene toward a high horizon.

title: Green Wheat Fields, Auvers
themes: fields, road, energetic brushwork, solitude, sky, late style
description: Undulating green fields and a pale road meet a turbulent blue-and-white sky; thick curling strokes animate an otherwise unpeopled landscape.

title: Flower Beds in Holland
themes: agriculture, geometric fields, labor, color bands, overcast light
description: Long rectangular flower plots form colored bands beneath a clouded sky, with a small worker, dark houses, and bare trees punctuating the geometry.

title: The Luncheon on the Grass
medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue laid paper
description: A black-line study places groups of figures in a wooded setting around a cloth on the ground.
